svg.aria-label: Quest log: AfroVoy, Sevently, Kunle Ilori Diamond, Olivia's Portfolio and Solufix Standard Cleaning, all live. Olivia peeks out from behind the card making a peace sign.
svg.title: Quests — five live projects

g.text: Real sites, live on the internet, each one a journey.
Every quest starts as a blank page
and ends as a live website that real people use.
